source.relation: read-only reshape; the source artifact is not modified by this module

contract: DISPLAY ONLY. efv_park_line.py is the model consumer of these factors and stays flag-gated OFF under the registered W2 M-FAIL verdict. Nothing here may be fed to a grade, a projection, a translation or a valuation.

method.run_pf: team-season (home RS+RA per game) / (road RS+RA per game) from StatsAPI schedule final scores, regular season only; centered on the unweighted LEAGUE-season mean ratio (registered centering; sport-season pooled fallback when a league is unlabeled or has under 4 rated teams); EB-shrunk toward 1.0 with K_G=70 home games; venue = modal home venue; venue-season = home-game-weighted mean; 3-season venue window uses only seasons <= t (vintage-safe)
method.hr_pf: team home/away HR per game from the league-wide team statSplits fetch (hitting HR + pitching HR allowed = all HR at the venue), same centering/shrink/window. hr_pf feeds NO frozen eFV formula (iso/slg neutralize via run_pf); it is carried for display/audit and clamped [0.80, 1.25] on read
method.note_2026: 2026 is in season; its factors use partial schedules plus the 2024-2025 window legs

meta.partial_note: 2026 is in season; its factors use partial schedules plus the 2024-2025 window legs
meta.displayed_value: trailing 3-season window ending at the venue's most recent rated season, vintage-safe (uses only seasons at or before that year). Single-season factors are deliberately absent: see verification.stability_reading.
meta.clamping: NONE. The [0.90, 1.10] run and [0.80, 1.25] HR bounds in the method block are application clamps for a model path that is switched off. Applying them to the display would compress 13 venues on run and 17 on HR, including turning Hodgetown's measured 1.209 into 1.100. The measured value ships.
meta.reading: 1.05 means the venue played about 5 percent more runs (or HR) than its league-season baseline, after shrinking toward neutral with K_G = 70 home games.
meta.percentile: rank within the same level among non-stale venues; suppressed for level pools under 8 venues
meta.stale: 1 when the venue has no team-season at the current season; its factor is a historical reading and it is left out of the percentile pool
meta.shared: 1 when more than one club called the venue home in its last rated season (the factor pools them)

series.wr: window run factor per season in meta.seasons order
series.gs: home games observed that season, same order; null where the venue was not rated

excluded.reason: StatsAPI's unlabeled-site bucket, not a ballpark; it pools every DSL club so its factor is 1.00 against itself by construction. Excluded from the display table.

meta.hr_coverage: 930 of 969 venue-seasons carry an HR factor; the gaps are complex-level sites with no team split fetched

verification.stability_reading: single-season run_pf year-over-year Spearman runs 0.353 to 0.479, under the 0.50 bar the R-PARK registration set, so single-season factors are NOT displayed. The independent split-half of the multi-season aggregate is 0.735 on run and 0.76 on HR, which clears it, so the trailing-window value is what ships.

pooled_non_venue.reason: StatsAPI's unlabeled-site bucket, not a ballpark; it pools every DSL club so its factor is 1.00 against itself by construction. Excluded from the display table.
